02 — Store Operations

Keeping the storefront commercially ready.

Full ownership of listings, pricing, variations and daily performance — the parts of a storefront that keep selling while the founder is offline.

What I handled

Shopee + TikTok Shop, day to day.

Execution that keeps product information accurate, performance visible, and pricing decisions grounded in current data.

  • Track key metrics daily (sales, orders, cancellations, conversion rate) and flag anomalies against the previous day.
  • Read the traffic vs. orders trend chart to time promos and restocks.
  • Keep an eye on ads spend and top-up settings so campaigns don't stall.
